details: Mix fixed lengths, fr units (shares of free space), minmax() and repeat(). repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr)) gives responsive columns without media queries.

values.note: As many 140px+ columns as fit; empty tracks stay.
Like auto-fill, but empty tracks collapse so items stretch.
First column may shrink below its content.
Use the parent grid’s columns (the element must itself be a grid item).

gotcha: 1fr has an automatic minimum of its content. Use minmax(0, 1fr) to let a column shrink further. subgrid only works on a grid that is itself placed in another grid, and it spans the parent tracks the item occupies.
